description: This file contains the implementation of an admin controller class 'Forgotten' for the Opencart e-commerce platform. It handles functionalities related to password reset, including requesting a reset, confirming a code, and setting a new password, with endpoints for each step.

classes.name: Forgotten
classes.description: Controller class for the admin password forgotten workflow, including password reset request, code confirmation, and password updating.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the forgotten password form or redirects logged-in users or if mail engine is not configured.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Handles the confirmation of a password reset code and displays the reset form if valid.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Handles the submission of the password reset request, validates the code, and allows the user to set a new password.

methods.name: password
methods.description: Displays the password change form and processes the password update.
